data.long_meaning: Viha, derived from the Sanskrit word 'vih', means 'shining' or 'radiant'. In Hindu mythology, Viha is associated with the goddess Lakshmi, symbolizing wealth, prosperity, and abundance. The name is a beautiful choice for a baby girl in Hindu tradition. The name Viha carries the meaning “Shining, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Viha usually hope their child will grow to embody shining, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
